entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Urmila Pandey And 5 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Sangam Singh,Brijesh Chand Kaushik Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Hari Narayan Singh Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Although, the matter had been called out in the revised list, none has appeared to press this writ petition.

Vide order dated 19.10.2022, the dispute had been referred for mediation as it was a matrimonial dispute giving rise to the First Information Report dated 29.07.2022, registered as Case Crime No.
0272 of 2022, under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 328, 376, 377 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Jhagaha, District Gorakhpur.
The report of the mediation proceedings has been placed before us.
The report indicates that the mediation failed despite mediation having been resorted to on 3 dates.
